purpose: Differentiate twelve existing farm buildings by architecture and roof silhouette. Farm produce stall, glass greenhouse laboratory and stone windmill retain their existing sprites.
processing: Remove tiny detached alpha components and retain a 1px alpha fringe; crop and contain to 488x488 aligned to the bottom within a transparent 512x512 canvas with 12px padding. Source originals are retained. Reproduce from repository root with prepare.cjs.
